responsibility: This implementation module is the empty companion body for the LegacyReal compatibility definition. It exists solely to complete the module pair for the REAL-to-SHORTREAL alias and contains no executable runtime behavior.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation companion to LegacyReal.def, but it contains no declarations or executable code beyond the empty module body. Unlike gcc/m2/gm2-libs/LegacyReal.def, it exists only to supply the implementation file for the alias module.
